newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares rebound, close 0.7 pct higher.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares rebound, close 0.7 pct higher.

text.p: 1225 GMT - Austrian shares recovered from a weak start to end 0.71 percent higher. Traders said the ATX index may break out of its current 1,020-1,040 points trading range and target 1,050. Renewed demand for OMV and AMS in the wake of recent losses.
* September ATX future up 7.5 points at 1,038.0
* AMS the biggest gainer, up 3.01 pct at 685 ats
* OMV by far most actively traded stock with volume of 47,954 lots. OMV ended 23.4 ats up at 1,009.
* Vienna Bourse index up 2.04 points at 404.63
